explanations.title: Severe drought: demand fully served
explanations.detail: No unserved energy in any modelled hour.

explanations.title: Severe drought: interconnector limit binding
explanations.detail: Imports are at the available transfer limit for 686 h (7.8% of the horizon). In those hours the marginal price is set by domestic scarcity, not by the import price.

explanations.title: Severe drought: battery cycling
explanations.detail: The battery discharges 749666 MWh (468.5 equivalent full cycles), shifting energy from low- to high-price hours.

explanations.title: Severe drought: system marginal cost
explanations.detail: Shadow price of the energy balance: mean 99.4, max 167.6 EUR/MWh. Values above the import price indicate binding supply constraints; values near VOLL (5000) indicate shortage hours.
